title: The Geometry of Becoming
subtitle: Motion, Information, and Thermodynamics Across Scales

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “The Geometry of Becoming” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.caption: Figure 8.1 — The Geometry of Becoming.
blocks.explanation: The origin poster: eighteen prompts that built a unified vision, tracing a path from an algebra of human range-of-motion to a geometry spanning motion, information, thermodynamics, life, agency, and cosmos. It records the three avoided pitfalls — drift, flatness, contradiction — and the hierarchical climb from kinematics through scales and information, thermodynamics and the arrow of time, semantics and agency, to life, mind, and clinical transitions. Framed explicitly as a map for twenty-first-century science, not a theory of everything: a framework for becoming everything.
blocks.tts: The Geometry of Becoming: eighteen prompts building one geometric language for motion, information, thermodynamics, and life across every scale.
